prompts.customer: Create a polished editorial illustration for a HubSpot consulting landing page. Landscape 3:2 composition. Subject: a calm, useful customer workspace — one large simplified customer profile card, with a small company building, two location pins, a document and a service conversation gathered neatly around it. The idea is a clear view of a customer's business, not a technical system diagram. Art direction for a cohesive four-image series: refined softly dimensional paper-cut illustration, matte surfaces, subtle grain, rounded edges, soft shadows, pale periwinkle-blue background, slate navy outlines, muted lavender and powder blue shapes, a restrained warm peach accent. Large simple shapes, generous negative space, human and approachable, sophisticated B2B editorial art. Minimal UI-like detail, no tiny interface elements. No arrows, no flowchart, no connector lines, no grids, no logos, no brand names, no words, no numbers, no client-identifying details. The illustration is visually distinct from a warm cream and copper webpage. Render as a finished raster illustration with an opaque background.
